fromFilings: Insider net, Short build, Last 8-K and 5% filing

rows.label: Market Cap
rows.equivalent: Diluted shares (weighted average) × price
rows.note: The release gives the quarter’s weighted-average diluted shares, not shares outstanding today, so this is near, not equal. Market value is the one money figure reliably in dollars; the Signal reads it.

rows.label: Revenue TTM
rows.equivalent: Revenue, four releases summed
rows.shown: Quarter only: Last Earning AI Extracted › Revenue
rows.note: Banks and insurers headline net revenue where the filings and Twelve Data total it: most of the disagreement.

rows.label: Gross profit
rows.equivalent: Gross profit as printed, else revenue less cost of revenue, four releases summed
rows.shown: Quarter margin: Last Earning AI Extracted › Gross margin; stock page strip
rows.note: Only about 44% of releases print gross profit as a line; with cost of revenue it reaches more. Banks have none.

rows.label: Net income
rows.equivalent: Net income attributable to the company, four releases summed
rows.shown: Quarter only: Last Earning AI Extracted › Net income
rows.note: A Signal input. Gaps are mostly non-controlling interests or preferred dividends in or out.

rows.label: FCF TTM
rows.equivalent: Free cash flow: the company’s own, else operating cash flow less capex, four releases summed
rows.shown: Quarter only: Last Earning AI Extracted › FCF; stock page card
rows.note: A different measure: Twelve Data’s is LEVERED free cash flow, computed by the provider after interest. Microsoft $16.5B against $60.0B from its releases ($67.0B in its 10-K). A Signal input.

rows.label: EBITDA
rows.equivalent: EBITDA as the company prints it (usually adjusted), four releases summed
rows.note: Only where the release prints it, and then usually the company’s ADJUSTED EBITDA under its own name. No filing figure to check against.

rows.label: Operating cash
rows.equivalent: Net cash from operating activities, the quarter (or the year to date less the release before), four summed
rows.note: Fewer releases print a cash flow statement (about 40% read for it), so coverage is the limit, not accuracy.

rows.label: Revenue / employee
rows.equivalent: Revenue yes; employees no
rows.note: Releases do not give a head count; the 10-K does, once a year.

rows.label: Enterprise value
rows.equivalent: Market value + debt lines − cash and short-term investments
rows.note: Rides on the debt definition, which differs (leases, commercial paper, other borrowings).

rows.signal: Company type (priced on earnings; no P/E and no Quality reads as a fund)
rows.label: Fwd P/E
rows.equivalent: None: needs analysts’ estimates
rows.note: Analysts’ forecasts are sold by data vendors; no filing has them. A Signal input (company type).

rows.label: Trailing P/E
rows.equivalent: Price / GAAP diluted EPS of four releases
rows.shown: Quarter EPS: Last Earning AI Extracted › EPS GAAP
rows.note: Twelve Data computes it at the price of its own last pull, up to a week old (within 6% of today’s for 80% of companies): most of the gap is the price, not the EPS (Live P/E, on today’s price, agrees far better). A split inside the four quarters breaks the EPS sum.

rows.label: Live P/E
rows.source: today’s price / Twelve Data diluted EPS TTM
rows.equivalent: Today’s price / GAAP diluted EPS of four releases
rows.note: As Trailing P/E: the price is the same on both sides, so the gap is the EPS.

rows.label: P/E vs peers
rows.equivalent: None: built on forward P/E
rows.note: Follows forward P/E.

rows.label: PEG
rows.equivalent: None: needs forecast growth
rows.note: Analysts’ growth forecasts.

rows.label: P/B
rows.equivalent: Market value / equity at the quarter’s end
rows.note: Equity in the release is the company’s share (non-controlling interests apart); the market value comes from Twelve Data either way.

rows.label: P/S
rows.equivalent: Market value / revenue of four releases
rows.note: As Revenue TTM.

rows.label: EV / sales
rows.equivalent: As Enterprise value, over revenue of four releases
rows.note: Carries the debt definition.

rows.label: EV/EBITDA
rows.equivalent: Enterprise value over the company’s EBITDA, where printed
rows.note: Two definitions in one: debt, and the company’s adjusted EBITDA.

rows.label: P / op cash
rows.source: market value / operating cash flow TTM
rows.equivalent: Market value / operating cash flow of four releases
rows.note: As Operating cash.

rows.label: Earnings yield
rows.equivalent: GAAP EPS of four releases / price
rows.note: As Trailing P/E.

rows.label: FCF yield
rows.equivalent: Free cash flow of four releases / market value
rows.note: Levered against unlevered: a different measure, as FCF TTM.

rows.label: Gross margin
rows.equivalent: Gross profit / revenue, four releases
rows.shown: Quarter: Last Earning AI Extracted › Gross margin; stock page strip
rows.note: A Signal input.

rows.label: Operating margin
rows.equivalent: Income from operations / revenue, four releases
rows.shown: Quarter: Last Earning AI Extracted › Op. margin; stock page strip
rows.note: Twelve Data’s is mostly the latest QUARTER’s, not twelve months’: it is within a point of the release’s quarter margin for 62% (2026-10-29) against 27% for the twelve months. Banks print no operating income.

rows.label: Profit margin
rows.equivalent: Net income / revenue, four releases
rows.note: A Signal input.

rows.label: FCF margin
rows.equivalent: Free cash flow / revenue, four releases
rows.note: Levered against unlevered. A Signal input.

rows.signal: Company type (the seventh point when Quality is off)
rows.label: ROE
rows.equivalent: Net income of four releases / equity at the quarter’s end
rows.note: Twelve Data divides by average equity; the release gives only the quarter-end figure, so expect a gap where equity moved. A Signal input (company type).

rows.label: ROA
rows.equivalent: Net income of four releases / total assets at the quarter’s end
rows.note: Average against quarter-end assets, as ROE.

rows.label: Rev grth Q YoY
rows.equivalent: Revenue against the same quarter a year earlier, both printed in the release
rows.shown: Last Earning AI Extracted › Rev YoY
rows.note: The same definition on both sides. A Signal input.

rows.label: Earn grth Q YoY
rows.equivalent: Net income against the same quarter a year earlier
rows.shown: Last Earning AI Extracted › Net income YoY
rows.note: Off a loss there is no rate on our side; Twelve Data sometimes gives one. A Signal input.

rows.label: EPS TTM
rows.equivalent: GAAP diluted EPS, four releases summed
rows.shown: Quarter: Last Earning AI Extracted › EPS GAAP
rows.note: A split inside the four quarters breaks the sum; quarter EPS do not add exactly.

rows.label: Cash
rows.equivalent: Cash and equivalents with short-term investments, quarter end
rows.shown: Last Earning AI Extracted › Cash; stock page strip
rows.note: Restricted cash and long-dated investments sit in or out depending on the company.

rows.label: Debt
rows.equivalent: The current and long-term debt lines as printed
rows.note: Definitions differ a lot (leases, commercial paper, other borrowings): it agreed with the filings’ total in only about 38%. Not a reliable swap.

rows.label: Net cash
rows.equivalent: Cash and short-term investments − the debt lines
rows.note: Carries the debt definition.

rows.label: Net cash / share
rows.equivalent: As Net cash, over diluted shares
rows.note: Debt definition and diluted against outstanding shares.

rows.label: Debt / equity
rows.equivalent: Debt lines / equity at the quarter’s end
rows.note: Twelve Data states it in percent (78 for 0.78); compared as a ratio here. Carries the debt definition.

rows.label: Current ratio
rows.equivalent: Current assets / current liabilities at the quarter’s end
rows.note: Banks and insurers do not split current from long-term.

rows.label: Net cash %
rows.equivalent: As Net cash, over market value
rows.note: Carries the debt definition.

rows.label: Dividend yield
rows.equivalent: Not read (some releases announce the dividend)
rows.note: A forward rate. The dividend a release declares could be read; the reader does not ask for it today.

rows.label: Payout ratio
rows.equivalent: Not read
rows.note: Would follow a dividend reading.

rows.label: Shareholder yield
rows.source: Twelve Data dividend yield + buyback yield (filings)
rows.equivalent: Buybacks from the filings already; dividend yield is Twelve Data’s
rows.note: Half from the filings already.

rows.label: Dividend rate
rows.equivalent: Not read
rows.note: As Dividend yield.

rows.label: Ex-dividend
rows.equivalent: Not read
rows.note: Dividend declarations come in their own 8-Ks or the release; not read.

rows.label: Dividend paid
rows.equivalent: Not read
rows.note: As Ex-dividend.

rows.label: Period
rows.equivalent: The quarter’s end, as the release states it
rows.shown: Last Earning AI Extracted › Quarter end
rows.note: The release names the newer quarter days before Twelve Data does: a median of 6 days in the measurement (90th percentile 16).

rows.signalIndirect: Indirect: the last report date feeds our next-report estimate (earndate.js), which the Earnings soon rule reads when no announced date is listed
rows.label: Reported
rows.equivalent: The day the results 8-K was filed
rows.note: Ours is the SEC filing day. Not read by the Signal itself; it feeds the next-report estimate behind Earnings soon.

rows.label: Last split
rows.equivalent: None
rows.note: Splits come from the price provider.

rows.label: Shares out
rows.equivalent: Weighted-average diluted shares for the quarter
rows.note: Weighted diluted for the quarter against outstanding today: near, not the same. The 10-Q cover page has the outstanding count.

rows.label: Book value/share
rows.equivalent: Equity / diluted shares
rows.note: Diluted against outstanding shares.

rows.label: Float
rows.equivalent: None
rows.note: Filings give public float once a year (10-K cover), in dollars.

rows.label: Short ratio
rows.equivalent: None
rows.note: FINRA short interest is already read (Short build, days to cover); float is the missing half.

rows.label: Short % float
rows.equivalent: None
rows.note: A Signal input (a guard). Needs float.

rows.label: Short % out
rows.equivalent: None
rows.note: FINRA short interest over shares outstanding could replace it.

rows.label: Insiders
rows.equivalent: None
rows.note: The proxy statement has it once a year.

rows.label: Institutions
rows.equivalent: None
rows.note: The 13F load already counts institutional holders; a percent needs shares outstanding.

rows.label: Qual.
rows.source: our score, built from Twelve Data’s fields
rows.equivalent: Its inputs: margins, growth, ROE, net cash, from the releases where they exist
rows.note: Not a Twelve Data figure but made of them; it would move with its inputs. A Signal input.
